description: This file defines a UI component named 'FloatingCartButton' using LightningJS framework. The component displays a floating cart button with a cart icon and a count indicator, and subscribes to a store to update the cart count dynamically.

classes.name: FloatingCartButton
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing a floating cart button with cart icon and item count.

methods.name: goCart
methods.description: Navigates the user to the '/cart' route when the button is pressed.
